exposure: Type of cesarean section (elected vs. emergency)
Cervical dilation at time of cesarean
Ultrasound measured echo of uterine scar
cohort: 69 women diagnosed with PCSDs and 107 women with no PCSD who underwent cesarean delivery with singleton infants between April 2014 and December 2015
finding: Multiple factors, including age ≥30 years, BMI ≥27.30, premature rupture of membranes, elective cesarean section, post-operative anemia, WBC count ≥12.5 × 10(9) g/L, and retroposition of uterus, were associated with an increased risk of PCSDs.
